description: See the changes you asked someone else to approve. When you try to change a to-do, number, priority, project or issue that belongs to a seat your person does not hold, OTP does not apply it: it sends the owner a request and the change waits. This lists those requests with their status: pending, applied (approved and done), declined, failed (approved but could not be applied) or expired (7 days, no answer). Requires API key.
name: list_change_requests
